ctx.x: Do you remember any of the other clarinetists, how they held their instrument, if anybody else did that, that you ever from New Orleans had?

No, I don't remember anybody else that was more or less playing in an unorthodox style. Most of them? Most of them followed the same pattern. Yeah. And the only thing that I have found with the clarinet players in New Orleans is that they never seem to get away from the old Albert system. You find three-fourths of them a day still playing the Albert system. Yeah, Simeon and I.
